title: What is a rocket mass heater?
summary: A two-minute explanation of what a rocket mass heater is, starting from how a conventional wood stove works and why creosote and chimney fires occur. It shows how burning hot and storing the heat in thermal mass makes for an efficient heater.
why: Linked as the quickest way to grasp the rocket mass heater concept in threads on heating and thermal storage.
